{{Quote|What happened? Where's the droid?''"<br />"''The droid's gone. But there's good news: the Jedi's unarmed.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''It doesn't look like he has his lightsaber.|Cad Bane and Shahan Alama|audio=GoodNewsNoLightsaber.flac|<ref name="HC" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this '''IG-86 sentinel droid''' worked as an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. Built by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]], it was recruited in [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was hired to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from a [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. To accomplish this, Bane planned to take a group of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] as a hostages, and exchange them for Ziro.

The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] accompanied Bane, [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], and two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] when the posse headed to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to start the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|operation]] to free Ziro. At the entrance of the building, the team was challenged by a group of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], but with the help of [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], they were able to eliminate them, thereafter entering the building. After eliminating all of the guards and taking control of the structure, the team captured a crowd of senators at the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] of the building. The plan was threatened, however, when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was spotted inside the building.

Bane sent Alama and the sentinel droid to capture the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but Skywalker was able to conceal his presence. The pair then started to search for the Jedi in the rooms of the building. During the search, Skywalker used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Alama, convincing him that the pair had two more floors to check. When Alama and the droid split up to search the two remaining floors, Skywalker sneaked behind the droid and ambushed it. The droid fought back, but ultimately proved to be no match for the Jedi Knight. Skywalker smashed the droid against a nearby wall with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]], and dispatched it with its own damaged [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

==Biography==
===Raid on the Senate===
{{Quote|Here we go.|Cad Bane, ordering the droids to hide on the speeder|<ref name="HC" />}}
[[File:CadBanesGroupComfortRidePassengerAirspeeder-HostageCrisis.png|thumb|left|250px|The sentinel droid arrives at the Republic Executive Building with Cad Bane's posse.]]
Like all [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]], this droid was created by Holowan Mechanicals<ref name="TCWCG" /> to serve as an assassin droid.<ref name="EPG" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a bounty hunter named Cad Bane was hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to release Ziro Desilijic Tiure from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant.<ref name="DBCB">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref> Bane gathered a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to help him to free Ziro. The team contained [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] Aurra Sing, [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], bounty hunter Shahan Alama, two BX-series droid commandos, and three IG-86 sentinel droids: [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]], [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]], and this droid.<ref name="HC" /> Once the team was organized, they headed to the Coruscant to start the operation to free the Hutt.<ref name="TCWIO">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref>

On Coruscant, Bane planned to force the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to free Ziro by taking a group of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as hostages, and exchange them for the Hutt. Before going to the Republic Executive Building with two [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], the team split up. Bane, along with the sentinel droid, Alama, and the droid commandos, headed to the entrance of the building while the rest of the team waited on an adjacent tower. Before arriving at the airspace of the building with the droids and Alama, Bane ordered the droids to hide themselves on the speeder. At the entrance landing platform, the team was encountered by Senate Commandos, who demanded that Bane surrender, for the speeder had broken security protocols and arrived in the restricted area. Backed up by Sing's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] fire, the droids revealed themselves, attacking the surprised commandos with Alama and Bane. After the guards were eliminated, the team regrouped at the entrance. Leaving HELIOS-3D to the speeder and the droid commandos to remove the guards' corpses, the sentinel droid followed the rest of the posse inside the building.<ref name="HC" />

Moving forward inside the structure, the two sentinel droids led the team to the [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]],<ref name="HC" /> allowing Robonino to sabotage the building power distribution network<ref name="EPG" /> and control both [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and Republic Executive Building security system. Outside the room, the droids spotted a Senate commando on guard, whom they quickly targeted with their laser scopes and eliminated with their blaster rifles. Entering the control room, the sentinel droids opened fire at the room's occupied personnel droids. When the sentinel droid shot a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] droid, an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] tried to escape, but was gunned down. The team left Robonino to control the room, and moved on toward the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] of the Republic Executive Building. While in route, Bane eliminated most of the remaining guards with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], resulting in team procuring control of the entire building.<ref name="HC" />

===The hunt for Skywalker===
{{Quote|Skywalker! After him!|Cad Bane, to Shahan Alama and the sentinel droid|<ref name="HC" />}}
[[File:AlamaIG86Hunting-HC.png|thumb|right|250px|Shahan Alama and the sentinel droid while searching for Anakin Skywalker.]]
The team finally arrived at the East Wing, where a crowd of senators had gathered to discuss a [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|new bill]]. The sentinel droid emerged at Alama's side when the posse surrounded the senators and took them as a hostages. After informing [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about the situation, and ordering Palpatine to free Ziro the Hutt from the prison, Bane ordered the senators to hand over any communication devices. This was interrupted, however, as Bane spotted Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker in the building, and unsuccessfully attempted to shoot him. When Skywalker fled from the East Wing, Bane ordered Alama and the sentinel droid to pursue him. The pair rushed after the Jedi, and soon leaped in front of Skywalker, opening fire on him. Prior to the confrontation, Skywalker had given his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to his wife [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] as a gift, and was unable to face Alama and the droid in direct combat. He fled once more as the droid and the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] chased after him. In one of the halls of the building, Skywalker was able to hide himself in one of the rooms. Alama and the droid then started to search for him, checking the rooms one-by-one.<ref name="HC" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|No lightsaber cuts&hellip; Interesting.|Alama, upon finding the destroyed sentinel droid|audio=NoLightsaberCuts.flac|<ref name="HC" />}}
[[File:IG86Dead-HC.png|thumb|left|250px|Alama finds the destroyed sentinel droid.]]
When Skywalker made contact with Chancellor Palpatine via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], the pair heard him speaking, and walked toward the door of the room where Skywalker was hiding. In response, the Jedi Knight mind tricked Alama, convincing the bounty hunter, and subsequently the droid, that they had two more floors to check. Alama left with the droid, and the pair split to search both remaining floors. The droid went downstairs, while Alama went up.

When the droid moved downwards, Skywalker sneaked behind it, and attacked the droid with his bare hands. The droid fought back, and when Skywalker managed to grab its blaster rifle, the droid bent it to its destruction. Skywalker, however, Force pushed the droid against a nearby wall. Before the droid could recover, the Jedi smashed it apart with the rifle. After defeating the droid, Skywalker left the hall, and soon Alama reemerged and entered it. The bounty hunter was surprised when he found the still sparkling remains of the droid; upon noticing that there were no lightsaber cuts in the droid, he deduced that the Jedi was unarmed. Alama then reported back to Bane, who asked about the droid. After learning the situation, Bane sent Sing to help Alama capture Skywalker, in which they were successful. The sentinel droid would be the only casualty of the posse during the raid.<ref name="HC" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|So, this was the droid you faced on Coruscant, Anakin?''"<br />"''Or one like it.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Anakin Skywalker, on HELIOS-3D|<ref name="TCWHtH3">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]]</ref>}}
[[File:IG86Lamp-HC.png|thumb|right|250px|The sentinel droid using its searchlight.]]
As this droid was a Holowan Mechanicals-manufactured IG-86 sentinel droid, part of the IG-series of combat droids,<ref name="TCWCG" /> it bore a strong resemblance with another sentinel droid, HELIOS-3D.<ref name="TCWHtH3" /> During the raid on the Senate, it communicated with Shahan Alama by using [[Binary/Legends|Binary]]. It was equipped with a blaster rifle, and possessed several built-in utilities on its head, such as a searchlight, which helped the droid to see in dark areas, and a reflex sight, which the droid used to target certain enemies. The droid's body was painted for a white and dark gray,<ref name="HC" /> and its chest was emblazoned with a red sunburst sigil, which was marked for all of the droids of the team.<ref name="EPG" />

While in Cad Bane's posse, the droid followed the orders of Bane and Alama, and did not hesitate to attack Anakin Skywalker when ordered to do so. It even obeyed a mind tricked Alama's command to leave a room unverified, even though they both had heard voices from within it. During the search of Skywalker, the droid acted carefully, and moved vigilantly door to door. However, it was not watchful enough, and by the time it spotted Skywalker, the Jedi had already sneaked behind the droid and was able to engage it in combat.<ref name="HC" />

The droid was very strong,<ref name="EPG" /> being able to hold his own against Skywalker in a fistfight and bend his own blaster rifle beyond repair. However, it could not respond to Jedi [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], and did not recover in time from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] push, which led to its destruction.<ref name="HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television episode "[[Hostage Crisis]]."<ref name="HC" />
